speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are experiencing intense itching and have noticed red bumps on your thigh and other areas. To help me narrow down the cause, can you describe how these bumps look—do they appear in clusters or are they scattered, and are they raised or flat?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with intense itching of his right thigh region for the past few days. He also mentions the recent formation of ‘red bumps’ in the same area. The patient has recently attended a business conference in Miami. He has a past medical history of hypertension, diabetes type 2, and hyperlipidemia. The patient’s medication regimen includes enalapril, metformin, and atorvastatin. He denies any history of smoking or drinking.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet determined. I need to know if you have experienced fever, chills, or muscle aches recently, and whether any friends or colleagues at the conference have reported similar symptoms.
